children: GreenBlade started with a simple idea: lawn care should be dependable, fairly priced, and completely off your plate. No missed visits, no vague bills, no chasing anyone down.
We’re a local, licensed and insured crew that treats every yard like our own — the same faces each week, flat-rate plans you can count on, and a standing promise to make it right if it isn’t.

If something’s not right, we come back and fix it. Your lawn looking great is the whole job.
